header.title: NAND oversupply in 2027 drives contract prices into a downward cycle

s01_bottom_line.text: TrendForce forecasts NAND Flash bit supply growing 25-30% YoY in 2027 while Chinese CSP enterprise SSD order cuts exceed added US demand, driving contract prices to fall 0-5% QoQ in 1Q27 and all categories into a downward cycle from 2Q27. ⟨cited figures: forecast⟩
The article frames 2027 as a supply-demand reversal into oversupply with prices declining, driven by Chinese CSP order cuts outweighing North American demand growth. ⟨cited figures: forecast⟩
A pricing downturn beginning early 2027 would pressure NAND Flash suppliers' revenue and margins after a recent up-cycle; the article does not quantify the earnings impact on any listed company.
